success_rule_FROZEN.population: exactly the three frozen served_question_ids above, scored over rebuilt-39027045675's own bundle/question/admissibility files. No new threshold, no new bar, no new anchor.
success_rule_FROZEN.disclosure_gap_predicate: For a qid: product's own measured.query_concepts_under_covered is a non-empty list AND admissible is true AND NO finding/warning code (case-insensitive substring) contains any of the frozen disclosure markers ['concept', 'under_covered', 'undercovered', 'query_concept']. warning_count and blocking_count are published beside it but the predicate is the finding-code test, because a count can be nonzero for unrelated reasons.
success_rule_FROZEN.independent_recomputation_predicate: For a qid: re-derive the concept set with the frozen question_concepts() over the product question record and re-derive per-concept row counts with row_match_text()/deaccent() over the bundle. Publish the independently-zero set beside product's own measured.query_concepts_under_covered. AGREEMENT is both sets equal; DISAGREEMENT is published as a measured finding and does NOT by itself choose a verdict.

verdict_classes.DISCLOSURE_DEFECT_TRANSFERRED: at least one of the three qids satisfies disclosure_gap_predicate on rebuilt-39027045675. Exit 1. The negative result is KEPT.
verdict_classes.DISCLOSURE_DEFECT_NOT_TRANSFERRED: no qid satisfies disclosure_gap_predicate (every non-empty under-covered set is disclosed by a finding code, or every under-covered set is empty). Exit 0.
verdict_classes.NOT_MEASURED: any pin re-hash mismatch, missing artifact, malformed JSON, failed non-vacuity control, or environment error. Exit 2. NO verdict is emitted; never a silent pass.

success_rule_FROZEN.never_a_pass: a NOT_MEASURED run is never reported as NOT_TRANSFERRED; an empty under-covered set is never reported as a disclosure success; a warning_count>0 caused solely by unrelated finding codes never satisfies the disclosure predicate.
success_rule_FROZEN.no_threshold_edited: this hypothesis adds no frozen bar, changes no existing bar, and re-derives none. The accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders and human_gate_ready=false are untouched.

non_vacuity_controls_FROZEN: control_gap_detector_fires: a synthetic admissibility with non-empty under_covered, admissible=true, findings=[] must satisfy disclosure_gap_predicate.
control_disclosure_detector_fires: a synthetic admissibility with non-empty under_covered, admissible=true, findings=[{code:'query_concepts_under_covered'}] must NOT satisfy disclosure_gap_predicate.
control_empty_gap_is_not_a_defect: a synthetic admissibility with under_covered=[], admissible=true, findings=[] must NOT satisfy disclosure_gap_predicate.
control_independent_recompute_covers: a synthetic bundle row whose text contains a concept must not appear in the independently-zero set for that concept.
control_independent_recompute_zero: a synthetic bundle with no row containing a concept must appear in the independently-zero set.
product_decision_unlocked: Whether Product's rebuilt packet - the packet the accepted serve verdict actually covers - has made the ONE disclosure change Evaluation handed it in cycle 39113690481 (surface query_concepts_under_covered to the jurist). claim_ceiling: This run measures only the question-native concept-gap DISCLOSURE state of one rebuilt packet under one frozen predicate. It does not re-measure counter-label support, geometry, retrieval parity, jurist usefulness, or either frozen absolute bar; it does not re-run live retrieval; it does not change human_gate_ready or any DO-NOT-SERVE order. A transferred defect is a disclosure defect on the packet, not a claim that any decision IS or IS NOT supporting/limiting authority.
